meta.title: Racing Through Parted Seas
meta.description: Hurry on your way, before the enemies join forces, while the sea of Entropy is still parted.

units.rawText: Several minutes ago, inside the Watchtower at the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth of the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Several minutes ago, inside the Watchtower at the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth of the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Several minutes ago, inside the Watchtower at the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth of the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: Target status stable. Cipher key match complete. Binding No. 13 has been disengaged. Please disengage Binding No. 14.
units.displayText: Target status stable. Cipher key match complete. Binding No. 13 has been disengaged. Please disengage Binding No. 14.

spans.text: Target status stable. Cipher key match complete. Binding No. 13 has been disengaged. Please disengage Binding No. 14.

units.rawText: We've almost got the map, this is the last step...
units.displayText: We've almost got the map, this is the last step...

spans.text: We've almost got the map, this is the last step...

units.rawText:
As I study the silver polyhedron in front of me, I'm suddenly filled with a sense of dread, as though I've been caught in the act of committing some kind of forbidden blasphemy. 
I briefly tear my eyes away from what's in front of me and warily look around.
units.displayText:
As I study the silver polyhedron in front of me, I'm suddenly filled with a sense of dread, as though I've been caught in the act of committing some kind of forbidden blasphemy. 
I briefly tear my eyes away from what's in front of me and warily look around.

spans.text:
As I study the silver polyhedron in front of me, I'm suddenly filled with a sense of dread, as though I've been caught in the act of committing some kind of forbidden blasphemy. 
I briefly tear my eyes away from what's in front of me and warily look around.

units.rawText: —There is nothing.
units.displayText: —There is nothing.

spans.text: —There is nothing.

units.rawText: Atlas, how are things on your end?
units.displayText: Atlas, how are things on your end?

spans.text: Atlas, how are things on your end?

units.rawText: I saw a few Entropics, but most of them seem to have been lured away by Ally and Electra.
units.displayText: I saw a few Entropics, but most of them seem to have been lured away by Ally and Electra.

spans.text: I saw a few Entropics, but most of them seem to have been lured away by Ally and Electra.

units.rawText: Those two girls are doing a great job. I'll need to praise them when I get back.
units.displayText: Those two girls are doing a great job. I'll need to praise them when I get back.

spans.text: Those two girls are doing a great job. I'll need to praise them when I get back.

units.rawText: ...Right. I'm almost done with the decryption here, but things are going TOO well. I have a bad feeling about this...
units.displayText: ...Right. I'm almost done with the decryption here, but things are going TOO well. I have a bad feeling about this...

spans.text: ...Right. I'm almost done with the decryption here, but things are going TOO well. I have a bad feeling about this...

units.rawText: Relax, buddy. I'll keep you safe until the very end!
units.displayText: Relax, buddy. I'll keep you safe until the very end!

spans.text: Relax, buddy. I'll keep you safe until the very end!

units.rawText: I'll be counting on you, then.
units.displayText: I'll be counting on you, then.

spans.text: I'll be counting on you, then.

units.rawText: I take a deep breath and banish my errant thoughts before focusing my attention on my work.
units.displayText: I take a deep breath and banish my errant thoughts before focusing my attention on my work.

spans.text: I take a deep breath and banish my errant thoughts before focusing my attention on my work.

units.rawText: Decryption complete. Now recovering the Rubik's Map... hm?
units.displayText: Decryption complete. Now recovering the Rubik's Map... hm?

spans.text: Decryption complete. Now recovering the Rubik's Map... hm?

units.rawText: The moment I touch the map, an eerie sensation ripples out from it in all directions.
units.displayText: The moment I touch the map, an eerie sensation ripples out from it in all directions.

spans.text: The moment I touch the map, an eerie sensation ripples out from it in all directions.

units.rawText: A sudden sense of discomfort seizes me by the throat, and I let go of the map.
units.displayText: A sudden sense of discomfort seizes me by the throat, and I let go of the map.

spans.text: A sudden sense of discomfort seizes me by the throat, and I let go of the map.

units.rawText: <cmdr>?
units.displayText: {교수}?

units.rawText: I'm fine! How are things on your end, Atlas?
units.displayText: I'm fine! How are things on your end, Atlas?

spans.text: I'm fine! How are things on your end, Atlas?

units.rawText: ...Atlas?
units.displayText: ...Atlas?

spans.text: ...Atlas?

units.rawText: The transmission is suddenly cut off. I quickly call him again but get no response.
units.displayText: The transmission is suddenly cut off. I quickly call him again but get no response.

spans.text: The transmission is suddenly cut off. I quickly call him again but get no response.

units.rawText: Rumblerumblerumble—
units.displayText: Rumblerumblerumble—

spans.text: Rumblerumblerumble—

units.rawText: The loud grinding from outside the tower covers up the uncomfortable radio silence. Then, as the labyrinth walls finish shifting, Entropics flood toward the Watchtower.
units.displayText: The loud grinding from outside the tower covers up the uncomfortable radio silence. Then, as the labyrinth walls finish shifting, Entropics flood toward the Watchtower.

spans.text: The loud grinding from outside the tower covers up the uncomfortable radio silence. Then, as the labyrinth walls finish shifting, Entropics flood toward the Watchtower.

units.rawText: The system alert is strangely clear amidst the deafening sound of the labyrinth's shifting.
units.displayText: The system alert is strangely clear amidst the deafening sound of the labyrinth's shifting.

spans.text: The system alert is strangely clear amidst the deafening sound of the labyrinth's shifting.

units.rawText: <color=red>Warning: Spoof Code 100% ablated! Spoofing failed!</color>
units.displayText: Warning: Spoof Code 100% ablated! Spoofing failed!

spans.text: Warning: Spoof Code 100% ablated! Spoofing failed!

units.rawText: Oh no! Atlas is in danger!
units.displayText: Oh no! Atlas is in danger!

spans.text: Oh no! Atlas is in danger!

units.rawText: I quickly reach out to take the Rubik's Map, but a tentacle from under the plinth wraps around my hand.
units.displayText: I quickly reach out to take the Rubik's Map, but a tentacle from under the plinth wraps around my hand.

spans.text: I quickly reach out to take the Rubik's Map, but a tentacle from under the plinth wraps around my hand.

units.rawText: Skree...
units.displayText: Skree...

spans.text: Skree...

units.rawText: An Entropic? Where did it come from?!
units.displayText: An Entropic? Where did it come from?!

spans.text: An Entropic? Where did it come from?!

units.rawText: I swing my blade and sever the tentacle, but more Entropics swarm me. Liquid Entropy spreads from below the plinth of the map, creeping across the ground and trying to pull me into the abyss.
units.displayText: I swing my blade and sever the tentacle, but more Entropics swarm me. Liquid Entropy spreads from below the plinth of the map, creeping across the ground and trying to pull me into the abyss.

spans.text: I swing my blade and sever the tentacle, but more Entropics swarm me. Liquid Entropy spreads from below the plinth of the map, creeping across the ground and trying to pull me into the abyss.

units.rawText: I knew we wouldn't be getting the map so easily, but...
units.displayText: I knew we wouldn't be getting the map so easily, but...

spans.text: I knew we wouldn't be getting the map so easily, but...

units.rawText: As the Entropic hordes pour in, I grit my teeth and grab the map.
units.displayText: As the Entropic hordes pour in, I grit my teeth and grab the map.

spans.text: As the Entropic hordes pour in, I grit my teeth and grab the map.

units.rawText: I'll never let you have it!
units.displayText: I'll never let you have it!

spans.text: I'll never let you have it!

units.rawText: Well said, buddy!
units.displayText: Well said, buddy!

spans.text: Well said, buddy!

units.rawText: Shing—
units.displayText: Shing—

spans.text: Shing—

units.rawText: A mighty greatsword lands in front of me, cleaving apart the tentacles reaching toward me and keeping the Entropics at bay in the same motion.
units.displayText: A mighty greatsword lands in front of me, cleaving apart the tentacles reaching toward me and keeping the Entropics at bay in the same motion.

spans.text: A mighty greatsword lands in front of me, cleaving apart the tentacles reaching toward me and keeping the Entropics at bay in the same motion.

units.rawText: Atlas?!
units.displayText: Atlas?!

spans.text: Atlas?!

units.rawText: Good thing I got here in time! You okay, buddy?
units.displayText: Good thing I got here in time! You okay, buddy?

spans.text: Good thing I got here in time! You okay, buddy?

units.rawText: I'm fine, but the Entropics outside...
units.displayText: I'm fine, but the Entropics outside...

spans.text: I'm fine, but the Entropics outside...

units.rawText: Heh, as if I'd be trapped by so few Entropics. Don't go worrying for nothing.
units.displayText: Heh, as if I'd be trapped by so few Entropics. Don't go worrying for nothing.

spans.text: Heh, as if I'd be trapped by so few Entropics. Don't go worrying for nothing.

units.rawText: After quickly examining our surroundings, Atlas swings his sword and stands in front of me in a fighting stance. He turns aside and wipes away the operands oozing from the wound on his left arm.
units.displayText: After quickly examining our surroundings, Atlas swings his sword and stands in front of me in a fighting stance. He turns aside and wipes away the operands oozing from the wound on his left arm.

spans.text: After quickly examining our surroundings, Atlas swings his sword and stands in front of me in a fighting stance. He turns aside and wipes away the operands oozing from the wound on his left arm.

units.rawText: Careful, buddy. These Entropics may all be Low-Orders, but they're trickier than the ones we met before.
units.displayText: Careful, buddy. These Entropics may all be Low-Orders, but they're trickier than the ones we met before.

spans.text: Careful, buddy. These Entropics may all be Low-Orders, but they're trickier than the ones we met before.

units.rawText: There was some kind of weird ripple that spread out when I touched the Rubik's Map.. Perhaps that ripple strengthened these Entropics and stripped away our Spoof Codes.
units.displayText: There was some kind of weird ripple that spread out when I touched the Rubik's Map.. Perhaps that ripple strengthened these Entropics and stripped away our Spoof Codes.

spans.text: There was some kind of weird ripple that spread out when I touched the Rubik's Map.. Perhaps that ripple strengthened these Entropics and stripped away our Spoof Codes.

units.rawText: I open my terminal during the brief respite that Atlas bought us and note that the endlessly increasing Entropic signals on it are dyeing the Watchtower's minimap completely purple.
units.displayText: I open my terminal during the brief respite that Atlas bought us and note that the endlessly increasing Entropic signals on it are dyeing the Watchtower's minimap completely purple.

spans.text: I open my terminal during the brief respite that Atlas bought us and note that the endlessly increasing Entropic signals on it are dyeing the Watchtower's minimap completely purple.

units.rawText: Things have gone beyond our expectations. We need to withdraw ASAP. Let me plot a route out of the tower...
units.displayText: Things have gone beyond our expectations. We need to withdraw ASAP. Let me plot a route out of the tower...

spans.text: Things have gone beyond our expectations. We need to withdraw ASAP. Let me plot a route out of the tower...

units.rawText: You have the Rubik's Map, right buddy?
units.displayText: You have the Rubik's Map, right buddy?

spans.text: You have the Rubik's Map, right buddy?

units.rawText: Yeah, I put it away along with my tools. Good thing you got here in time. I've almost finished plotting a course, get ready to...
units.displayText: Yeah, I put it away along with my tools. Good thing you got here in time. I've almost finished plotting a course, get ready to...

spans.text: Yeah, I put it away along with my tools. Good thing you got here in time. I've almost finished plotting a course, get ready to...

units.rawText: No need to wait, we're going right now!
units.displayText: No need to wait, we're going right now!

spans.text: No need to wait, we're going right now!

units.rawText: Right now?
units.displayText: Right now?

spans.text: Right now?

units.rawText: Before I can react, Atlas clears a path for us with a sweep of his greatsword, then reaches out to pull me into his embrace and scoops me into a princess carry.
units.displayText: Before I can react, Atlas clears a path for us with a sweep of his greatsword, then reaches out to pull me into his embrace and scoops me into a princess carry.

spans.text: Before I can react, Atlas clears a path for us with a sweep of his greatsword, then reaches out to pull me into his embrace and scoops me into a princess carry.

units.rawText: Wha?
units.displayText: Wha?

spans.text: Wha?

units.rawText: Hold on tight, here we go!
units.displayText: Hold on tight, here we go!

spans.text: Hold on tight, here we go!

units.rawText: As Atlas breaks into a sprint, I suddenly realize what he's trying to do. Of course, the moment I do, I wish I hadn't—
units.displayText: As Atlas breaks into a sprint, I suddenly realize what he's trying to do. Of course, the moment I do, I wish I hadn't—

spans.text: As Atlas breaks into a sprint, I suddenly realize what he's trying to do. Of course, the moment I do, I wish I hadn't—

units.rawText: Atlas plants a foot on the edge of a windowsill and leaps outside. I reflexively hold out a hand and envelope us in a transparent barrier.
units.displayText: Atlas plants a foot on the edge of a windowsill and leaps outside. I reflexively hold out a hand and envelope us in a transparent barrier.

spans.text: Atlas plants a foot on the edge of a windowsill and leaps outside. I reflexively hold out a hand and envelope us in a transparent barrier.

units.rawText: Brace for impact!
units.displayText: Brace for impact!

spans.text: Brace for impact!

units.rawText: <size=40>Crash—</size>
units.displayText: Crash—

spans.text: Crash—

units.rawText: Amidst the nauseating sensation of vertigo followed by the fall and impact of landing, we escape the Watchtower.
units.displayText: Amidst the nauseating sensation of vertigo followed by the fall and impact of landing, we escape the Watchtower.

spans.text: Amidst the nauseating sensation of vertigo followed by the fall and impact of landing, we escape the Watchtower.

units.rawText: Back on firm ground again. You okay, buddy?
units.displayText: Back on firm ground again. You okay, buddy?

spans.text: Back on firm ground again. You okay, buddy?

options.rawText: Next time, let me know BEFORE you do something like this.
options.displayText: Next time, let me know BEFORE you do something like this.

spans.text: Next time, let me know BEFORE you do something like this.

options.rawText: You can put me down now, Atlas...
options.displayText: You can put me down now, Atlas...

spans.text: You can put me down now, Atlas...

units.rawText: Hehe, I thought we were so familiar with each other that you'd get my drift immediately.
units.displayText: Hehe, I thought we were so familiar with each other that you'd get my drift immediately.

spans.text: Hehe, I thought we were so familiar with each other that you'd get my drift immediately.

units.rawText: Hahaha, well, these are special circumstances; don't sweat the small stuff, buddy!
units.displayText: Hahaha, well, these are special circumstances; don't sweat the small stuff, buddy!

spans.text: Hahaha, well, these are special circumstances; don't sweat the small stuff, buddy!

units.rawText: There wasn't even a single Entropic around just now... Looks like your instincts were spot on.
units.displayText: There wasn't even a single Entropic around just now... Looks like your instincts were spot on.

spans.text: There wasn't even a single Entropic around just now... Looks like your instincts were spot on.

units.rawText: I'd rather my instincts not be accurate at all if they predict that kind of stuff.
units.displayText: I'd rather my instincts not be accurate at all if they predict that kind of stuff.

spans.text: I'd rather my instincts not be accurate at all if they predict that kind of stuff.

units.rawText: ...Anyway, seems like things aren't looking good. Not only is the tower filling up with Entropic signals, but the surroundings are also...
units.displayText: ...Anyway, seems like things aren't looking good. Not only is the tower filling up with Entropic signals, but the surroundings are also...

spans.text: ...Anyway, seems like things aren't looking good. Not only is the tower filling up with Entropic signals, but the surroundings are also...

units.rawText: Hold on tight, buddy!
units.displayText: Hold on tight, buddy!

spans.text: Hold on tight, buddy!

units.rawText: Wait a minute, are you planning to force your way out like this?
units.displayText: Wait a minute, are you planning to force your way out like this?

spans.text: Wait a minute, are you planning to force your way out like this?

units.rawText: You're our key to taking down Tartarus. I can't do anything to put you at risk.
units.displayText: You're our key to taking down Tartarus. I can't do anything to put you at risk.

spans.text: You're our key to taking down Tartarus. I can't do anything to put you at risk.

units.rawText: Nonono, I think you should put me down.
units.displayText: Nonono, I think you should put me down.

spans.text: Nonono, I think you should put me down.

units.rawText: Your combat modules aren't fully adjusted yet, so I think it's for the best. I'm here to protect both you and Lord Eosphorus, so this is my job. That being the case, I'll clear the path for you two, just like before.
units.displayText: Your combat modules aren't fully adjusted yet, so I think it's for the best. I'm here to protect both you and Lord Eosphorus, so this is my job. That being the case, I'll clear the path for you two, just like before.

spans.text: Your combat modules aren't fully adjusted yet, so I think it's for the best. I'm here to protect both you and Lord Eosphorus, so this is my job. That being the case, I'll clear the path for you two, just like before.

units.rawText: Although, if you really feel bad about it, you can help me with support skills like just now.
units.displayText: Although, if you really feel bad about it, you can help me with support skills like just now.

spans.text: Although, if you really feel bad about it, you can help me with support skills like just now.

options.rawText: I mean, this isn't a good position for fighting, right?
options.displayText: I mean, this isn't a good position for fighting, right?

spans.text: I mean, this isn't a good position for fighting, right?

options.rawText: Can I please request that you hold me a different way?
options.displayText: Can I please request that you hold me a different way?

spans.text: Can I please request that you hold me a different way?

units.rawText: That's true, both my hands are occupied. I gotta hand it to you, buddy, I get it now.
units.displayText: That's true, both my hands are occupied. I gotta hand it to you, buddy, I get it now.

spans.text: That's true, both my hands are occupied. I gotta hand it to you, buddy, I get it now.

units.rawText: I see. I thought this one was the most comfortable for you, but it seems I got things wrong.
units.displayText: I see. I thought this one was the most comfortable for you, but it seems I got things wrong.

spans.text: I see. I thought this one was the most comfortable for you, but it seems I got things wrong.

units.rawText: I sigh in relief upon seeing that Atlas understands my suffering.
units.displayText: I sigh in relief upon seeing that Atlas understands my suffering.

spans.text: I sigh in relief upon seeing that Atlas understands my suffering.

units.rawText: In that case, let's try this. Hup!
units.displayText: In that case, let's try this. Hup!

spans.text: In that case, let's try this. Hup!

units.rawText: Hm? What's this? Why is this nothing like what I expected?
units.displayText: Hm? What's this? Why is this nothing like what I expected?

spans.text: Hm? What's this? Why is this nothing like what I expected?

units.rawText: Upon seeing my perspective flip 180 degrees, a sense of weakness fills my heart.
units.displayText: Upon seeing my perspective flip 180 degrees, a sense of weakness fills my heart.

spans.text: Upon seeing my perspective flip 180 degrees, a sense of weakness fills my heart.

units.rawText: Alright, position changed, let's go! Don't move around too much now, buddy.
units.displayText: Alright, position changed, let's go! Don't move around too much now, buddy.

spans.text: Alright, position changed, let's go! Don't move around too much now, buddy.

units.rawText: Atlas is carrying me over his shoulder like a sack of rice.
units.displayText: Atlas is carrying me over his shoulder like a sack of rice.

spans.text: Atlas is carrying me over his shoulder like a sack of rice.

units.rawText: Wait...
units.displayText: Wait...

spans.text: Wait...

units.rawText: No time to wait, they're starting to surround us! Let's go!
units.displayText: No time to wait, they're starting to surround us! Let's go!

spans.text: No time to wait, they're starting to surround us! Let's go!

units.rawText: And with that, Atlas swings his weapon and rushes toward the Entropic blockade.
units.displayText: And with that, Atlas swings his weapon and rushes toward the Entropic blockade.

spans.text: And with that, Atlas swings his weapon and rushes toward the Entropic blockade.

units.rawText: Much as I hate to admit it, it's a crude yet highly effective method. Before the Entropics can close the trap, we've soon shaken off their pursuit.
units.displayText: Much as I hate to admit it, it's a crude yet highly effective method. Before the Entropics can close the trap, we've soon shaken off their pursuit.

spans.text: Much as I hate to admit it, it's a crude yet highly effective method. Before the Entropics can close the trap, we've soon shaken off their pursuit.

units.rawText: Whew... You okay, buddy?
units.displayText: Whew... You okay, buddy?

spans.text: Whew... You okay, buddy?
...I'm feeling... carsick... no... mansick...

options.rawText: I think my self-esteem has taken a critical hit.
options.displayText: I think my self-esteem has taken a critical hit.

spans.text: I think my self-esteem has taken a critical hit.
I'm okay, how are you?

units.rawText: Hahaha, well, if you can still crack jokes, you must be in pretty good shape.
units.displayText: Hahaha, well, if you can still crack jokes, you must be in pretty good shape.

spans.text: Hahaha, well, if you can still crack jokes, you must be in pretty good shape.

units.rawText: Hahaha, well, if you can still crack jokes, you must be in pretty good shape.
units.displayText: Hahaha, well, if you can still crack jokes, you must be in pretty good shape.

spans.text: Hahaha, well, if you can still crack jokes, you must be in pretty good shape.

units.rawText: Just a few scratches. It's no big deal!
units.displayText: Just a few scratches. It's no big deal!

spans.text: Just a few scratches. It's no big deal!

units.rawText: Atlas finally lowers me from his shoulder.
units.displayText: Atlas finally lowers me from his shoulder.

spans.text: Atlas finally lowers me from his shoulder.

units.rawText: Man, that was close. There were enough Entropics in there to drown us if we hadn't reacted quickly enough.
units.displayText: Man, that was close. There were enough Entropics in there to drown us if we hadn't reacted quickly enough.

spans.text: Man, that was close. There were enough Entropics in there to drown us if we hadn't reacted quickly enough.

units.rawText: The decryption went very well and no alarms triggered. The only possibility is...
units.displayText: The decryption went very well and no alarms triggered. The only possibility is...

spans.text: The decryption went very well and no alarms triggered. The only possibility is...

units.rawText: After performing some quick first aid on Atlas, I look at the Rubik's Map in my hand.
units.displayText: After performing some quick first aid on Atlas, I look at the Rubik's Map in my hand.

spans.text: After performing some quick first aid on Atlas, I look at the Rubik's Map in my hand.

units.rawText: Alright, alright, stop moping. It was hard, but we finished our mission in the end! Let's tell everyone else the good news!
units.displayText: Alright, alright, stop moping. It was hard, but we finished our mission in the end! Let's tell everyone else the good news!

spans.text: Alright, alright, stop moping. It was hard, but we finished our mission in the end! Let's tell everyone else the good news!

units.rawText: Yeah, I'd like to ask about the change in the Labyrinth just now and that creepy wave thing...
units.displayText: Yeah, I'd like to ask about the change in the Labyrinth just now and that creepy wave thing...

spans.text: Yeah, I'd like to ask about the change in the Labyrinth just now and that creepy wave thing...

units.rawText: Dootdootdoot— Beep—
units.displayText: Dootdootdoot— Beep—

spans.text: Dootdootdoot— Beep—

units.rawText: ...What's wrong?
units.displayText: ...What's wrong?

spans.text: ...What's wrong?

units.rawText: After seeing the frown on Atlas' face, I try to call Eos as well. However, there is no response beyond the crackling of static.
units.displayText: After seeing the frown on Atlas' face, I try to call Eos as well. However, there is no response beyond the crackling of static.

spans.text: After seeing the frown on Atlas' face, I try to call Eos as well. However, there is no response beyond the crackling of static.

units.rawText: It's not only our main channel; even the backup comm channels are down as well.
units.displayText: It's not only our main channel; even the backup comm channels are down as well.

spans.text: It's not only our main channel; even the backup comm channels are down as well.

units.rawText: Was the signal cut off inside the tower? Or was it that ripple...
units.displayText: Was the signal cut off inside the tower? Or was it that ripple...

spans.text: Was the signal cut off inside the tower? Or was it that ripple...

units.rawText: In that case, we'd better think about how to meet up with the others... hm?
units.displayText: In that case, we'd better think about how to meet up with the others... hm?

spans.text: In that case, we'd better think about how to meet up with the others... hm?

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: A golden arrow lights up Tartarus' darkened skies.
units.displayText: A golden arrow lights up Tartarus' darkened skies.

spans.text: A golden arrow lights up Tartarus' darkened skies.

units.rawText: It's an emergency signal from Alcyone and Electra!
units.displayText: It's an emergency signal from Alcyone and Electra!

spans.text: It's an emergency signal from Alcyone and Electra!

units.rawText: A sense of uneasiness wells up in me again.
units.displayText: A sense of uneasiness wells up in me again.

spans.text: A sense of uneasiness wells up in me again.

units.rawText: Oh no, given Alcyone's personality, she's the kind of person who won't ask for help unless she absolutely has to... buddy, the map!
units.displayText: Oh no, given Alcyone's personality, she's the kind of person who won't ask for help unless she absolutely has to... buddy, the map!

spans.text: Oh no, given Alcyone's personality, she's the kind of person who won't ask for help unless she absolutely has to... buddy, the map!

units.rawText: Got it. Coordinates confirmed, beginning search...
units.displayText: Got it. Coordinates confirmed, beginning search...

spans.text: Got it. Coordinates confirmed, beginning search...

units.rawText: I quickly open the Rubik's Map. The labyrinth's structure and key points appear before my eyes.
units.displayText: I quickly open the Rubik's Map. The labyrinth's structure and key points appear before my eyes.

spans.text: I quickly open the Rubik's Map. The labyrinth's structure and key points appear before my eyes.

units.rawText: Head south, then push forward while sticking to the Outer Ring... If we avoid fighting the enemy before the next labyrinth shift, it'll take us around 30 minutes to get there.
